name: 沈师五分划
description:
每周5天，依次练胸、背、腿、肩、手臂。

训练原则（按原计划保留）
1. 不要受伤，保持稳定的力量训练。
2. 充分休息，每个肌群训练间隔48小时以上。
3. 动作质量优先，避免代偿，专注目标肌群发力。

训练细节
复合动作组间休息90–120秒（记录默认120秒），孤立动作60秒。不要选择8RM以下的重量，尽可能选择能完成12次的重量。全程控制；初始重量由你确认，计划不自动加重。

Day 1：胸部训练
目标：胸大肌（整体厚度、上中下束分化）
1. 平板杠铃卧推：4 × 12。下落到大臂平行地面；下放和发力均保持控制。
2. 上斜哑铃卧推：4 × 12。上胸强化。
3. 双杠臂屈伸：4 × 力竭。4组×力竭；下胸和肱三头肌。做不了时用上斜俯卧撑替代。
4. 绳索夹胸：3 × 12。细节雕刻。

Day 2：背部训练
目标：背阔肌、斜方肌
1. 引体向上（宽握）：4 × 力竭。4组×力竭；拉不了时用高位下拉替代。
2. 坐姿划船（器械或绳索）：4 × 12。固定器械或绳索均可；背阔肌中下束。
3. 单臂哑铃划船（每侧）：3 × 12。每侧12次；单侧控制。
4. 直臂下压：4 × 12。背阔肌。

Day 3：腿部训练
目标：股四头肌、臀肌、腘绳肌、小腿
1. 杠铃深蹲：4 × 12。全程控制；下放至大腿平行地面，膝盖不内扣。
2. 腿屈伸：4 × 12。股四头肌。
3. 保加利亚分腿蹲（每腿）：3 × 12。每腿12次；单侧稳定性。
4. 倒蹬机：3 × 12。下放到底；股直肌强化。
5. 坐姿腿弯举：3 × 12。腘绳肌孤立。

Day 4：肩部训练
目标：三角肌前、中、后束均衡发展
1. 坐姿杠铃推举：4 × 12。前束和整体肩部。
2. 哑铃侧平举（递减组）：4 × 12。4组×12次，采用递减组；原计划未指定减重比例，由用户调整。
3. 反向飞鸟：3 × 12。三角肌后束。
4. 器械推肩：3 × 12。辅助孤立前束。
5. 面拉（高位）：3 × 12。后束和上背联动。

Day 5：手臂训练
目标：肱二头肌、肱三头肌
1. 杠铃弯举（21响礼炮）：4 × 21。每组21次，全程控制。
2. 牧师凳弯举：3 × 12。集中发力。
3. 锤式弯举：3 × 12。肱肌和肱二头肌长头。
4. 窄距俯卧撑：4 × 力竭。4组×力竭；肱三头肌强化。
5. 绳索臂屈伸：3 × 12。肱三头肌长头。
6. 凳上臂屈伸（负重）：3 × 12。肱三头肌整体；记录额外负重。

腹部可选附加训练（不计入五天循环）
1. 悬垂举腿：慢速10次×5组，后期可增加到10组；每天或每2天一次。
2. 坐姿举腿：每天20次×5组。
腹部安排与主计划分开选择；主计划中的力竭组记录实际完成次数。

localizedDescription.en:
Five sessions per week, rotating chest, back, legs, shoulders and arms.

Source training principles
1. Avoid injury and maintain consistent strength training.
2. Rest adequately; allow more than 48 hours between sessions for each muscle group.
3. Prioritize movement quality, avoid compensation and focus on the intended muscles.

Training details
Rest 90–120 seconds for compound movements (120-second default) and 60 seconds for isolation work. Avoid loads heavier than an 8RM and aim for a load you can complete for 12 repetitions. Keep every repetition controlled. Confirm starting loads yourself; this plan does not increase them automatically.

Day 1：Chest
Target: Pectorals: overall thickness and upper, middle and lower regions
1. Flat Barbell Bench Press：4 × 12。Lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor; control both lowering and pressing.
2. Incline Dumbbell Bench Press：4 × 12。Upper-chest emphasis.
3. Parallel-Bar Dip：4 × AMRAP。4 sets to failure; lower chest and triceps. Substitute incline push-ups if needed.
4. Cable Chest Fly：3 × 12。Chest isolation.

Day 2：Back
Target: Latissimus dorsi and trapezius
1. Wide-Grip Pull-Up：4 × AMRAP。4 sets to failure; substitute lat pulldowns if needed.
2. Seated Machine or Cable Row：4 × 12。Use a fixed machine or cable; middle/lower lat emphasis.
3. One-Arm Dumbbell Row (Each Side)：3 × 12。12 repetitions per side; controlled unilateral work.
4. Straight-Arm Pulldown：4 × 12。Lat emphasis.

Day 3：Legs
Target: Quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings and calves
1. Barbell Squat：4 × 12。Control the full repetition; lower to thighs parallel and avoid knees collapsing inward.
2. Leg Extension：4 × 12。Quadriceps isolation.
3. Bulgarian Split Squat (Each Leg)：3 × 12。12 repetitions per leg; unilateral stability.
4. Leg Press：3 × 12。Lower through the prescribed range; rectus femoris emphasis.
5. Seated Leg Curl：3 × 12。Hamstring isolation.

Day 4：Shoulders
Target: Balanced anterior, middle and posterior deltoid work
1. Seated Barbell Shoulder Press：4 × 12。Anterior deltoid and overall shoulder emphasis.
2. Dumbbell Lateral Raise (Drop Sets)：4 × 12。4 sets of 12 using drop sets; the source does not specify drop percentages, so adjust loads manually.
3. Reverse Fly：3 × 12。Posterior deltoids.
4. Machine Shoulder Press：3 × 12。Supplementary anterior-deltoid work.
5. High Cable Face Pull：3 × 12。Posterior deltoids and upper back.

Day 5：Arms
Target: Biceps and triceps
1. Barbell Curl (21s)：4 × 21。21 repetitions per set with controlled movement.
2. Preacher Curl：3 × 12。Focused contraction.
3. Hammer Curl：3 × 12。Brachialis and biceps long-head emphasis.
4. Close-Grip Push-Up：4 × AMRAP。4 sets to failure; triceps emphasis.
5. Cable Triceps Extension：3 × 12。Triceps long-head emphasis.
6. Weighted Bench Dip：3 × 12。Overall triceps; record additional load.

Optional abdominal work (outside the five-day rotation)
1. Hanging leg raises: 5 sets of 10 slow repetitions, increasing to 10 sets later; daily or every other day.
2. Seated leg raises: 5 sets of 20 repetitions daily.
Choose abdominal work separately from the main rotation. Log actual completed repetitions for AMRAP sets.
